title: The kinds of place, facility and event, and what apps call them
notes: Every app uses these names for a kind, so a district is a District and a community is a Communities group everywhere.
singular names one of the kind (a Type row, a card). plural names the group or heading.
A Place is a territory: a district, a city or town, a community, or the county. A Facility is a building or site, shown beside Places. An Event is a gathering.
An Area is a named neighborhood, valley or part of a city that is not a city, town or community of its own. A Region is a larger part of the county that holds several communities.
